initial_repair: Rollout scheduling env TMS overrides; later disproved by the colocated worker fork

weight_backup_followup.repair: Enable official enable_weights_cpu_backup through an OPD-local SGLangConfig extension; reject LoRA colocation without backup.
weight_backup_followup.secondary_finding: OPD thinking=false was not transmitted on ordinary requests; only forced-final requests carried it.
